Acher found illegal moves in 61 of 67 games, but those failures do not establish defective internal world models. The specialized chess study finds learned board representations, leaving the broader claim unsettled.

The medication study and NOHARM establish potentially harmful recommendations, but neither connects those failures to absent explicit world models. They support the risk warning without settling its causal explanation.

Karvonen's chess study recovers learned board states and changes move generation by intervening on them. This specialized model directly challenges the categorical claim that everything language models do is mimicry.
